sections.heading: New
items: SRT/WebVTTT support: Import .srt/.vtt subtitle files as caption.
Editable track names: Agent can now label tracks to better organize your project.
Copy settings: Right click a clip -> Copy -> Paste Setttings, or ask the agent to do it.
Text Tilt: New styling option for text in inspector panel.
sections.heading: UI
items: Preview caption directly on the canvas when choosing a caption style.
Agent activity highlight on the timeline: When agent is working on the clips, the timeline will highlight the related clips for better visualization.
